name: death-and-taxes-bot
description: Self-hosted automation bot for the DeathAndTaxes on-chain game (defense + game-strategy, Flashbots inclusion).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @dat-bot/backend && npm run build -w @dat-bot/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @dat-bot/backend && npm run test -w @dat-bot/backend && npm run test -w @dat-bot/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @dat-bot/backend
